say:3:1210733002:1.text: I'm getting old after all. Not as sharp as before...
say:3:1210733002:1.source_cn: 到底还是老了，不如以前了……

say:4:1210733003:1.text: If I were younger, stronger, more agile... you wouldn't stand a chance.
say:4:1210733003:1.source_cn: 如果我还年轻，体魄强健，手指灵活……你们不是我的对手。

say:5:1210733004:1.source_cn: 属于你的时代已经过去了。

say:7:1210733006:1.text: You could have lived out your days in peace.
say:7:1210733006:1.source_cn: 你本来可以安度晚年的。

say:8:1210733007:1.text: *Deep chuckles* Retirement? Sitting on my thumbs, soaking up the sun? I'd rather die!
say:8:1210733007:1.source_cn: 呵呵……安度晚年？无所事事地吹海风、晒太阳？那种生活…...

say:9:1210733008:1.text: Sonja, from the day I took you in, I knew you'd rise to the top. You'd be my right hand.
say:9:1210733008:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，收养你的时候，我就知道你会有出息。你会成为我的...

say:10:1210733009:1.text: But now... You can't do this to me! I built the Whispers up through my blood, sweat, and tears. This gang would be nothing without me!
say:10:1210733009:1.source_cn: 但是，你不能夺走我的生命。对于一个掌控帮派的老人，失去...

say:11:1210733010:1.text: If only you were truly my child... then I'm sure you would be much more loyal.
say:11:1210733010:1.source_cn: 多希望你真的是我孩子……那样你就会永远在身边辅佐我。

say:12:1210733011:1.text: You already control way too many people. I'm glad I'm not one of them.
say:12:1210733011:1.source_cn: 你手下的亡魂太多。我很庆幸我不是。

say:13:1210733012:1.text: Do not forget that I am the one who made you what you are! Deny it all you want, but you will never escape me... Hahahaha!!!
say:13:1210733012:1.source_cn: 我亲手塑造了你，即便你不承认，你也永远没法摆脱我……哈...

say:19:1210733014:1.text: Shut your mouth. Don't think you'll get a quick, easy death by taunting us.
say:19:1210733014:1.source_cn: 放轻松，只是卸了你的下巴。

say:20:1210733015:1.text: Our score isn't settled yet. I'll gladly wait until the day you're judged in court and you can finally face your sins.
say:20:1210733015:1.source_cn: 想自尽？别啊，我们俩的恩怨还没算，你怎么可以去死呢？

choice_prompt:21:1210733015.text: Our score isn't settled yet. I'll gladly wait until the day you're judged in court and you can finally face your sins.
choice_prompt:21:1210733015.source_cn: 想自尽？别啊，我们俩的恩怨还没算，你怎么可以去死呢？

say:22:1210733016:1.text: You guys go on ahead. I'll join you after I tie him up nice and properly so that he can't escape before he goes to trial.
say:22:1210733016:1.source_cn: 放心，你们继续找，我留在这里把他绑起来，免得他缺席血薇...
say:22:1210733016:1.male: You guys go on ahead. I'll join you after I tie him up nice and properly so that he can't escape before he goes to trial.
say:22:1210733016:1.female: You guys go on ahead. I'll join you after I tie him up nice and properly so that he can't escape before he goes to trial.

say:24:1210733018:1.text: Don't worry, I'll catch up to you guys soon!
say:24:1210733018:1.source_cn: 放心，我稍后就赶上你们。

choice:21:0:1.text: We still need to find Nara.
choice:21:0:1.male: We still need to find Nara.
choice:21:0:1.female: We still need to find Nara.
